profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary: Systems, Software & Integrated Software/Hardware, Test, Evaluation & Engineering Professional with more than 19 years of technical experiences, where the past years had been instrumental in the support, operation and maintenance of operational real-time systems and real-time software applications to include testing, integration and verification of new software baselines. Prior 3 years has been dedicated to Ground Element Software and System Integration and Evaluation Testing for NG Space System, and to which 10 years contributed solely in performing ICBM related-experiences not limited to Software Development, Design, Implementations, Modifications, Nuclear Safety Cross Check Analysis, Performance Analysis Testing Evaluation, and Independent Verification and Validation. Provide Test Witnessing of Software Testing as the Representative for the Lead Developmental Test Organization (LDTO) and/or alt-LDTO ensuring the test conductors are testing according to approved Test Plans and Test Procedures. Broad knowledge of design, requirements, testing, and evaluation of software/hardware for the Minuteman III (MMIII) programs and GBSD. Extensive experience in the use of Xilinx's Virtex-4 ML-403 FPGA Development Board for testing / evaluation / validation / verification of specific programs. Proficient experience in troubleshooting, debugging, analyzing, and building programs with Freescale's EVB9S12XEP100 Microcontroller Evaluation Board for specific programs. Additionally, my experience from both the integration areas of Hardware and Software has benefited various engineering projects as well as value-added member of the team and asset to the company. My willingness and combined experienced with hands-on technology and integration and test, allows me to complete evaluations, testing, collaboration, review boards and finalize documentations and engineering summaries within schedule, providing lower risk and mitigation for our customers.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Software Applications Specialist
positions.locationName: Redondo Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Support and maintain operations and documentation of software applications to keep operation feasibility of software modifications, primarily focused on the support and maintenance of real-time software applications. Provide Software Leadership as the primary POC in support of successful program execution for the Software Installation. Support to include interfacing with the Installation Managers, Software/Hardware Testers, reviewing of Test Plans, Test Procedures and/or other Testing documentations. Develop and support software tools to complement software maintenance activities including verification that software standards are met. Perform a diverse set of tasks in support of real-time operations and operations development. Oversee and lead reviews, updates and validation of standard operating procedures, and training material for multiple generations of systems. Develop, maintain, and utilize monitoring tools/scripts in Perl, Python, MATLAB, DCL, VAX/VMS.  Completed a vigorous certification training as a Systems Controller for multi-generations systems.  Provide operation support directly as a systems controller ensuring at least four days of crew shift is completed every quarter, maintaining competencies and shift work proficiency. Review and support factory design working groups and future systems development activities for impacts to system operability, including interfacing with government customers and specialists. Utilized agile processes and experienced with Atlassian tools that include Jira, Confluence, Git and Bitbucket, to coordinate software and departmental tasking through Kanban boards. Assist training department in execution classroom instruction and simulator training. Provide excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and the ability to interface with software, hardware, and systems test engineers, system administrators, and program/function management.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Principal Software Engineer for the SIT and SEIT team of the Payload and Ground Systems within Space Systems Sector, my day to day varies from performing software integration tests, writing/executing formal qualification test procedures, collaborate on scripting automated tests using industry leading toolset, developing test approaches for new software capabilities using scripting languages like Perl, Python, Java/C++ in a Red Hat Enterprise Linux environment and providing the best support from a software engineering discipline. To put it simply, daily, weekly, and monthly software to system integration testing through hands-on testing, evaluation, integration, and collaboration with various sub-system engineers, from component levels up through management! Provided Software Technical Support for System Engineering & Integration Testing at local facility and at customer’s facility – utilizing technical skills in evaluation, testing, documentation, collaboration with other engineers and staff at customer’s facilities, to include leading and conducted testing events for major milestone test events, Provided and supported software upgrades and installation at customer’s facility, and worked various hours and shift in-support of the critical mission in CONUS and OCONUS facilities.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer / Scientist
positions.description: Test Engineer supporting the various efforts as the Technical Management Advisory Services (TMAS) on behalf of Arnold Engineering Developmental Complex (AEDC) as the Lead Development Testing and Evaluation Organization (LDTO) for the MMIII Sustainment and GBSD Acquisition efforts.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Support · Interpersonal Skills · Programming · Aerospace · Communication · Computer Science · Object-oriented Software · Technical Engineering

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
—Test Manager for the SACCS-R replacement program providing insight and assistance to the team in terms of Testing & Evaluation ensuring the team is operating according to regulations and processes 
—Review and engaged in the witnessing of various Systems, Components and Integration Testing for the Weapon System sustainment programs. 
—Provide technical Testing and Evaluation of Test Plans, Test Procedures, Specifications, Requirements and various CDRL documentations to ensure the Program is operating under AFI and System Directorate regulations. 
—Engaged in the highest level of communication with the various project teams for the weapon system 
—Lead the development of a critical software design for the facility logging system 
—Managed system engineering and project plans for Test Project Request and Engineering Project Support for various weapon system projects
—Provide and prepared sustainment and acquisition concept to the ICBM System Program Office 
—Managed/Designed/Implemented (CM) Configuration Management database within localized network using FileMaker Pro and Advance Pro (Administration level usage) 
—Fully Managed/Designed/Developed/Integrated Request Forms for tracking request for testing and engineering support at the integration complex – using the latest version of Adobe LiveCycle Designer ES4. 
—Fully Managed/Designed/Developed/Integrated a Logging Task program for the integration complex – using the latest version of NetBeans for Java Developers/ Java EE.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Support · Interpersonal Skills · Programming · Aerospace · Communication · Flight Control · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Object-oriented Software · Technical Engineering · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: System Engineer II
positions.description:
-Perform Nuclear Surety Cross Check Analysis (NSCCA), Performance Analysis Technical Evaluation (PATE), and Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) processes for the Minuteman III (MMIII) Inter Continental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) weapons system. 
-Perform requirements analysis, systems analysis, code analysis, functional testing analysis, regression testing analysis, and conducted actual functional and regression testing
-Articulated critical comments/feedbacks during Peer Reviews/Meetings on the Interface Control Documents (ICD), Interface Requirements Documents (IRDs), Preliminary Interface Descriptions (PIDS), and Software Detail Description (SDD) to the customer that could adversely affect the system. 
-Attended and provide technical support at Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), at Critical Design Reviews (CDR), and at Test Readiness Review (TRR) 
-Specifically represented the RFSE Team at the CDR when the Lead Engineer requested 
-Took initiative in preparation (in both testing and documentation) for the team's Certification Demonstration to the customer on the COP program, and on the RFSE program 
-Generated test procedures during extensive functional testing and regression testing of major updates in the code on the COP program, and the RFSE program. 
-Provided working knowledge of FPGA/Embedded Systems experience to promote various testing capabilities for the WSP Mod program, and the RFSE program. 
-Proactively and attentively engaged in documentation reviews with fellow team and with the customers, ensuring requirements are thoroughly met and correct 
-Demonstrated positive and productive personality while working on the COP team during requirements analysis, code analysis, formal testing, Software Change Request (SCR) analysis, and comments review. 
-Engaged in the highest level of communication with the COP Team, the RFSE Team, the WSP Mod Team, the A4 Team, and the STACS Team
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Customer Support · Programming · Aerospace · Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Object-oriented Software · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)

positions.title: Eng. Scientist II
positions.description:
-Setup and create firmware and script development for design engineers to implement.  -Assist designers with FPGA designs. 
-Assist and evaluated VHDL design and company’s coding guidelines. 
-Create and maintain a SOP (Standard of Operation) manual for Linux System Administration. 
-Support design engineers in FPGA firmware development in terms of simulation and processes. 
-Prepare presentation for PDR (Preliminary Design Review) and CDR (Critical Design Review). 
-Help in redesign of electrical system directly related to critical power supply CCAs. 
-Use Cadence Allegro to both capture and simulate new schematic designs with PSPICE. 
-Implement microcontroller/DSP interface design and associated firmware development. 
-Provide direct support to layout designers using printed circuit board layout tools (such as Mentor Graphics and Cadence) to further troubleshoot design works.  
-Administrative task for creating new users and new projects on the GRID.  
-Maintain workload for current and incoming Interns in the EE department. 
-Continued residual task on a daily basis in providing administrative support to the GRID and all users currently on the GRID.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Customer Support · JavaScript · Programming · Communication · Computer Science · Object-oriented Software · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)
